english.title: Passenger fail to give name / address on request to driver / inspector / conductor of public service vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a passenger on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) used for the carriage of passengers at separate fares, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to provide your name and address on demand to the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[inspector]_

when that person reasonably suspected that you had contravened a provision of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25(3) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
